audit.summary: Two ad formats (320×480 and 300×600) exhibit solid layout discipline and brand alignment, but contain three findings: a critical missing series title overlay in the 320×480 header, minor CTA spacing tightness in the 300×600, and a polish opportunity on price presentation. All text is readable, logo and product imagery are visible, colors conform to the palette, and French copy is natural. Blockers are limited to the missing SÉRIE SÖDERHAMN label in the 320×480 animated/settled states; the remainder are warn-level polish or spacing refinements.

findings.issue: Missing 'SÉRIE SÖDERHAMN' text in header during animated and settled states. The initial state shows 'SÉRIE SÖDERHAMN' top-right in gold, but it disappears in animated/settled screenshots, breaking visual consistency and leaving the header incomplete.
findings.fix_hint: Ensure the .header-title or equivalent element with text 'SÉRIE SÖDERHAMN' (font-family: 'Noto Sans', font-weight: 700, color: #FBD914) remains visible in all states. Verify CSS does not hide it via opacity: 0, display: none, or animation keyframes; add it as a persistent DOM node if missing from HTML.

findings.issue: CTA button 'Voir tous les modèles' appears to have minimal bottom padding/margin inside the #ad-300x600 frame. While readable and functional, the button sits closer to the frame edge than recommended best practice.
findings.fix_hint: Add padding-bottom: 12px; or margin-bottom: 12px; to the .cta-button or #ad-300x600 footer wrapper to create visible breathing room above the ad frame boundary.

findings.issue: Price presentation ('DÈS 349€') uses white/light text on yellow background. While legible, the layout could benefit from a tighter, more premium hierarchy between the 'DÈS' label and the price figure.
findings.fix_hint: Consider font-weight: 700 on the price figure (349€) and font-size: 28px+ to create stronger visual emphasis. Keep 'DÈS' at font-size: 13px, font-weight: 400 for contrast. Verify hex colors: background #FBD914, text #111111 (dark gray from palette).

audit.regeneration_prompt: 1. 320×480: Restore 'SÉRIE SÖDERHAMN' text element (gold #FBD914, Noto Sans 700) in the header. Ensure it remains visible (opacity: 1) throughout all animation states; do not hide on keyframe. 2. 300×600: Add padding-bottom: 12px; margin-bottom: 12px; to the CTA button or footer div for safe frame margin. 3. 300×600: Increase price figure font-size to 28px and font-weight: 700; keep 'DÈS' at 13px 400; verify yellow background #FBD914 and text #111111.
